data.action: 抱膝坐在泳池边双腿浸水，紧身死库水勾勒出丰满身段，侧脸微红眼神纯情
data.camera: full body, seated side three-quarter view
data.description: 体育课后静谧的学园露天游泳池瓷砖台阶旁，微风拂起水波。唯身穿规矩正统的深蓝色连体死库水，胸前白布名牌清晰写着“古手川”。她抱膝坐在清凉的池边，修长白嫩的匀称美腿自然浸在水中。水珠顺着她柔嫩的肩膀与黑色直发滑落，她侧过微红的脸庞看着走来的梨斗，纯情少女的心事在波光粼粼的水面悄然荡漾。
data.lighting: 澄澈热带骄阳与碧蓝池水反射出的灵动焦散水波光斑
data.location: 学校露天游泳池深蓝瓷砖台阶边
data.promptProse: Yui turns from the pool edge with her knees drawn close and her lower legs still in the water, her long black hair damp over the navy swimsuit. Short brown-haired Rito approaches along the tiles in a white athletic shirt and dark shorts. Reflected sunlight drifts across her shoulders while his profile comes into view.
data.title: 古手川唯 · 校园池畔的死库水抱膝静候
data.animaCaption: Long black-haired Yui sits at the edge in her navy school swimsuit, lower legs in the water. She turns as short spiky brown-haired Rito approaches along the tiles in a white athletic T-shirt and dark shorts.
